title: Present Perfect Basics

vocab.ex: Have you ever lived abroad?
She has achieved a lot this year.
I have never had this opportunity.
I have finished my homework.
She has finished her homework.
We haven't finished yet.
He hasn't called me back.
She has gone to the gym.
I have seen that movie before.
We have eaten there many times.
I have been to Italy twice.
She has done a great job.
I have known him for years.
They have spoken about it already.
He has taken the exam twice.
I have written two emails today.
This trip was a great life experience.
Up to now, everything has been fine.
This week is an unfinished time period.
Present perfect connects past and present.
So far, we have finished two tasks.
I have recently changed jobs.
She has been busy lately.
I have called her twice this week.
We have travelled a lot this year.
I've is the contraction of I have.
She has completed the project.
I have tried sushi many times.
They have visited Rome before.
We have lived here for ten years.

expressions.example: So far, so good with the new job.

sentences: I have known him for years.
They have spoken about it already.
We have lived here for ten years.
I have tried sushi many times.

grammar.title: Present Perfect: have/has + particípio passado
rules: Estrutura: have/has + past participle. Have para I/you/we/they, has para he/she/it.
Pergunta: Have/Has + sujeito + particípio?: "Have you been there?"
Use quando NÃO há um momento específico — a ação conecta o passado com o presente.

speak: Have you ever been to Japan?
I have known him for years.
